name: hf-range-planner
description: Browser-based HF skywave propagation planner: frequency-to-footprint and point-to-point best-band, driven by live solar weather and an analytic ionospheric model.

scripts.dev:worker: npm run build && npx wrangler@4 dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler@4 deploy
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test:unit

author: Dean Bird
